intro: {{nameA}} and {{nameB}} both offer {{course}} in the Hyderabad region of Telangana. This page compares recorded fees, placements and ranks from our database and official ranking pages opened in {{year}}.
CMR College of Engineering & Technology vs KG Reddy College of Engineering and Technology is a local private comparison. CMR is the only side with a 2025 NIRF Engineering rank on this page, at 201.

sections.heading: CMR College of Engineering & Technology vs KG Reddy College of Engineering and Technology for B.Tech: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose CMR if you want a 2025 NIRF Engineering rank and the higher recorded 2023 highest package on this page, at ₹58 lakh, with a 2023 average of ₹4 lakh.

Choose KG Reddy if a slightly higher recorded year fee is acceptable and you have checked its latest official placement report. Our KG Reddy record is from 2020, with an average of ₹4 lakh and a highest of ₹10 lakh.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show
paragraphs: Our records list tuition of ₹75,000 a year for CMR. Treat this as a recorded year fee, not a confirmed four-year total, until you check the college's current fee notice.
KG Reddy has recorded tuition and a year-wise total of ₹78,000. The two sides are close on recorded year fees. Confirm TS EAMCET or management-quota circulars, which can differ.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: CMR's recorded 2023 figures are an average package of ₹4 lakh and a highest package of ₹58 lakh. These are historical outcomes, not a salary promise. The gap between average and highest is wide, so read the official report, not only the top offer.
KG Reddy's recorded 2020 figures are an average of ₹4 lakh and a highest of ₹10 lakh. The years are not the same, so the two packages should not be read as a same-batch comparison.

sections.heading: Admission and eligibility
paragraphs: KG Reddy lists JEE Main on this page. CMR has no exam listed in our records here, but Hyderabad engineering seats are commonly filled through TS EAMCET and, for some seats, JEE Main.
Confirm the current TS EAMCET counselling brochure and each college's admissions page before you apply. Class 12 PCM remains the usual academic requirement.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Both colleges are in the Hyderabad region of Telangana. The city is shared; the NIRF standing and the placement year are not.
Visit both campuses if commute, hostel and lab facilities will decide the choice for you.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: On the data we hold, CMR is the more documented side: a 2025 NIRF Engineering rank of 201 and a 2023 placement year.
KG Reddy's recorded year fee is only slightly higher, but its placement record here is older, from 2020, and it has no NIRF Engineering rank on this page.
Confirm official fee notices for your quota, and read CMR's full placement report before you lean on the ₹58 lakh highest figure alone.

faqs.question: Which is better in 2026, CMR College of Engineering or KG Reddy, for B.Tech?
faqs.answer: CMR has a 2025 NIRF Engineering rank of 201 and 2023 figures of a ₹4 lakh average and a ₹58 lakh highest package. KG Reddy has no NIRF Engineering rank here and a 2020 record of a ₹4 lakh average and a ₹10 lakh highest package.

faqs.question: What are the recorded B.Tech fees for CMR vs KG Reddy?
faqs.answer: Our records list ₹75,000 a year for CMR and ₹78,000 a year for KG Reddy. These are recorded year figures, not confirmed four-year totals. Confirm the official notice for your quota.

faqs.question: Which exams do CMR and KG Reddy accept?
faqs.answer: KG Reddy lists JEE Main on this page. CMR has no exam listed in our records here. Hyderabad engineering admissions commonly also use TS EAMCET. Check the current counselling brochure.

faqs.question: How do placements compare for CMR and KG Reddy?
faqs.answer: CMR's recorded 2023 average is ₹4 lakh and the highest is ₹58 lakh. KG Reddy's recorded 2020 average is ₹4 lakh and the highest is ₹10 lakh. The years differ, and the CMR gap between average and highest is wide.

faqs.question: Are CMR and KG Reddy in the same city?
faqs.answer: Both are in the Hyderabad region of Telangana, on different campuses. Visit both if the exact commute matters.
